name: IHRISCurrency
title: iHRIS Currency
description: The `currency` list as shipped by default in iHRIS 4.3.3 (modules: ihris-common/module/iso-currency). Codes are the iHRIS record ids. Deployments add their own records, so this is the shipped baseline, not a closed international code set. 30 record(s) sharing an id with an earlier one were merged, as I2CE's configuration tree merges them.

property.description: iHRIS MAP field `country`: a code in the country list
